question: Is UD-Q4_K_XL the right dev checkpoint for agentic CODE work (vs ps-iq2xxs which loops)?
method: Existing gates re-run with EXPERTPIN_NCMOE=40 (UD needs 4 extra CPU-MoE layers to fit 28 GiB VRAM; NCMOE=36 peaked 28.15 GiB and the guard refused fail-closed) + the new code-precision gate: an agent must WRITE a small script, RUN it, and the gate probes the ARTIFACT independently (not the agent self-report). Reasoning off (the new dev default).
verdict: UD-Q4_K_XL WINS for agentic code work

code_precision_gate.ps: FAIL — command flattened to one line (exit 2), script never existed, model still answered the marker: EXACT reproduction of the real-use loop failure
code_precision_gate.ud: PASS — script written with real newlines + required for-loop, ran clean, printed exactly code-gate-ok-7391 (independent artifact probe; runner died on the pre-fix start-clock bug while the orphan client completed — probe + transcript preserved)

recommendation: Switch the Expertpin dev provider default to UD-Q4_K_XL (NCMOE=40, reasoning off) for agentic code work; keep ps-iq2xxs for throughput-critical non-code tasks.
